notes: Six-hour agent timeout (override_timeout_sec=21600) on the fixed-QEMU TB2.1 snapshot; a modified evaluation, not a leaderboard-eligible configuration.

bench-run cohort on HF Jobs (Harbor b20373d6) with the published fast-agent-mcp 0.10.43 wheel; Claude Haiku 5.5 (medium reasoning) through GitHub Copilot. Zero whole-trial retries; fast-agent's own provider retries apply. Five infrastructure failures (two sandbox setup timeouts, two read timeouts, a dropped connection) were rerun as replacements; the originals are kept as evidence.

Cost shown is a list-rate estimate repriced from each trial's token usage (bench-run reprice, card-packs catalog 2026-10-10.1): Harbor's fast-agent adapter charged prompt-cache writes as plain input. Recorded $18.27; repriced $18.87 over the same 448 trials. The run used GitHub Copilot, so this is a list-price equivalent, not what Copilot billed. Some trials have model calls that reported no usage, so the total is a lower bound.
